Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and restricted cervical
rnage of motion. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with the nature and force of the impact. Over the course of care,
the patient completed 27 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically expected for a cervical strain of this type, and treatment
included manual therapy, therapeutic exercise, and home stretching instruction. Imaging and physical examination findings
clearly confirm the presence of soft tissue injury to the cervical region. No prior injury or treatment involving the same body area
is known to this provider. Billing records were reviewed and do not show duplicate or repeated charges for the same services.
The patient's smyptoms improved gradually with conservative care, and a final evaluation documented ongoing but reduced neck
discomfort with near-normal range of motion. Continued home exercise and as-needed follow-up were recommended.
